#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

struct BalanceChecker {
    int w;
    int n;
    int* a;
    BalanceChecker(int w, int n, int* a) : w(w), n(n), a(a) {}
    bool check() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ) {
            if (a[i] <= 1) {
                i++;
                continue;
            }
            a[i] += 1;
            if (a[i] == w) {
                while (i <= n && a[i] >= w) {
                    a[i] = 0;
                    i++;
                    a[i] += 1;
                }
            } else {
                i++;
            }
            if (a[i - 1] > 1) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
};

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    int a[52] = {0}; // 1-indexed, extra space for carry
    int n = 0;
    do {
        a[++n] = m % w;
        m /= w;
    } while (m > 0);
    BalanceChecker bc(w, n, a);
    cout << (bc.check() ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
